findings.summary: `enrollmentReceipt` has no field representing the live ruleset’s required-status-check entries or their external-check integration binding. It can therefore validate while only asserting check names and unrelated IDs, without evidencing that the active ruleset actually requires `ITD external review gate` from the enrolled GitHub App and `ITD machine oracle` from Actions.
